summary.name: Filmora 16
summary.one_liner: Wondershare Filmora 16 is AI-powered video editing software for desktop and mobile, with timeline editing, AI media analysis, screen recording, color grading, captions and a large library of creative assets.
use_cases: organizing and finding shots in footage
cleaning up shaky or noisy footage
summary.what_it_does: Filmora organizes imported or recorded footage using AI Media Analysis, which tags people, scenes, actions, speech and key moments and generates summaries and edit suggestions. Its screen recorder captures screen, camera, microphones and system audio as separate sources for independent editing. The timeline editor supports rough-cut tools and motion controls, plus picture cleanup for clarity, lighting, shake and noise. Color correction includes a Color Mask for refining areas with HSL, curves and color wheels. Sound tools cover voiceovers and balancing, and speech can be turned into editable, styled captions. The page also mentions export in multiple formats and project handoff, and a library of over 2.9 million creative assets.
notable: AI Media Analysis that tags footage and suggests edits
Screen recorder capturing screen, camera, mics and system audio as separate editable sources
Color Mask for targeted grading of faces, skies and backgrounds
Library of 2.9M+ creative assets (templates, effects, music, stock media)
caveats: Pricing is not stated on the page; the directory listing tags it as free, but this is not confirmed here.
Platform details beyond 'desktop and mobile' are not specified on the page.
